summary: Godrej Properties reported a 42% year-on-year drop in net profit after tax to ₹350 crore in the first quarter of FY27, with total income falling 16% to ₹1,337 crore. An article from inventiva alleges that Godrej Properties is involved in a subvention model controversy with Canara Bank, raising questions about real-estate financing and risk transfer. The company's profit before tax and EBITDA also declined 44% and 40% respectively. An investigation into alleged subvention arrangements and home-loan financing has raised questions about Godrej Properties' operations in the National Capital Region.
